name: Davco® Tile & Grout Cleaner
summary: Davco® Tile & Grout Cleaner is a specially formulated to clean tough dirt and stains from tiles and grout. Davco® Tile & Grout Cleaner can be used to remove minor Efflorscence.
metaDescription: Davco Tile & Grout Cleaner is a specially formulated to clean tough dirt and stains from tiles and grout. Davco Tile & Grout Cleaner can be used to remove minor Efflorscence.
usage: Davco® Tile & Grout Cleaner is suitable for most common tiled surfaces.
Davco® Tile & Grout Cleaner can remove minor Efflorescence from grout surfaces.
Removes tough dirt and stains from tiles and aged grout and helps remove mould and mildew from grout surfaces.
Suitable for most types of tiles including; ceramic, porcelain, mosaic, quarry and slate tiles

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: 12 Months from date of manufacture if unopened

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store in dry cool conditions off ground out of direct sunlight.

items.label: MIXING
items.text: Add Tile & Grout Cleaner to a clean plastic bucket and dilute with water at a ratio of 10 parts water to 1 part Tile & Grout Cleaner (5L of water to 500ml Tile & Grout Cleaner).

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text:
Always use a saturated mop or sponge to wet down the surface with clean water before applying product 1. For normal cleaning, dampen a mop or sponge with the solution and wipe over the surface before rinsing immediately with clean warm water.
. For heavily soiled areas apply a greater quantity of the solution. Allow the affected area to soak for up to 10 minutes and then scrub with a stiff nylon brush before rinsing well with clean warm water.
